# OpenTender

> Australian tender and bid writing with fixed, published prices and dated
> turnarounds. OpenTender keeps a calendar of government contracts and when
> they end, so tenders are found before they are advertised. Any industry,
> Australia wide. Run by Matt Sharp.

## What OpenTender does

- Keeps a calendar of government contracts built from the buyers' own
  registers: who holds each contract, what it is worth, and when it ends. A
  contract that ends in March goes back to tender before March, usually three
  to twelve months before anything is advertised.
- Writes the tender response when a client decides to bid: compliance matrix,
  technical answers, site-specific method, in the buyer's own template.
- Checks the site inspection date first on any live tender. Most councils make
  the inspection mandatory, so a tender that can no longer be inspected is
  already dead.

## Prices (published, + GST)

- Council standard tender response: $3,000, back in 5 business days.
- Full RFT (state, university, hospital, facilities management, multi-site):
  $5,000, back in 10 business days.
- Panel, multi-region or whole-of-state: quoted in writing from $7,500.
- Watch (monthly calendar for one patch, incumbents named, site inspection
  dates flagged): $500 a month, no lock-in, a fortnight's notice.
- Nothing is owed until the client has read a draft and decided they want it
  finished. Invoice on delivery, payable in 7 days.

## Coverage

Federal, state and council buyers across Australia. Any industry with a public
contract; the calendar runs deepest in cleaning, waste, security, grounds,
catering, trades and facilities management.

## Straight answers

- OpenTender never predicts a win. The promise is a complete, compliant
  response lodged before the deadline.
- Client pricing is always the client's: OpenTender does not price the work.
- Client documents are stored in Australia, used only for that client's
  tenders, and never put into public tools.
- No testimonials are published until they are real and named.
